column3: Close to the Greek; the critical text prints 7:53–8:11 but marks it as a later addition.
NKJV adds “as though He did not hear,” found in some manuscripts but not in the critical text.

NKJV includes “being convicted by their conscience” and “even to the last,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “having heard, they went out one by one, beginning with the older ones.”
NKJV includes “saw no one but the woman” and “those accusers of yours,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Woman, where are they?”
NKJV supplies “I am with” in “I am with the Father who sent Me.”
NKJV names “Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “He spoke.”
NKJV renders the difficult Greek answer as “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning”; the meaning is uncertain.
NKJV has “My Father,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Father.”
NKJV has “The Father,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He has not left Me alone.”
